nodes.contract: Select exactly one full-head T1w per BIDS session. Retain companion identities. Structural checks do not constitute anatomical QC.

Consume t1w_manifest in its declared order. Create an isolated FreeSurfer subject directory and convert each T1w to numbered mri/orig/001.mgz, 002.mgz, etc. Emit orig_dir with the ordered files and provenance for motion correction. Implement the directory/manifest adapter and use the registered mri_convert command for conversion.

parameters.filled_pretess: per-hemisphere label 255/127 with norm_mgz before tessellation

nodes.contract: Preserve filled_mgz; run official mri_pretess independently for lh=255/rh=127 using norm_mgz, as in recon-all second pretess. Preserve and publish both actual initializer volumes. Validate finite labels, physical grid and label changes involving the target label; preserve the original filled volume and record other-label-to-target transitions introduced by the official connectivity correction. Tessellate the matching corrected label volume and preserve tkregister-RAS and native volume geometry. Record voxel changes and initializer paths; subsequent topology and self-intersection gates remain mandatory.

For each lh/rh, copy the bound orig_nofix_surf and same-subject brain_mgz, wm_mgz and orig_mgz into an isolated SUBJECTS_DIR. Measure the raw surface, prepare smoothwm.nofix, inflated.nofix and qsphere.nofix, then run locked FreeSurfer mris_fix_topology -ga into a new orig_topofix_surf. Preserve the raw input and publish all preparation meshes separately. Independently require Euler=2 and total defect index=0 and finite output geometry before publishing. Record raw/fixed hashes, vertex/face counts, indexing changes and actual self-intersecting vertices; topology fixing may change indexing. Residual self-intersections must be passed to anat_remove_intersection, not approved or bypassed. Do not generate orig_surf, orig_premesh_surf or downstream overlays in this node. When topology_recovery_attempts is nonempty, independently preview native intersection cleanup for the primary candidate. Only if cleanup leaves intersections, run the finite configured recovery attempts with their seed and patch smoothing count, reusing the same raw/smoothed/inflated/quick-sphere inputs. Preserve every candidate, cleanup result, command and measurement under distinct paths. Publish the first topology candidate whose native cleanup has Euler=2, zero defects, zero intersections and valid finite geometry/correspondence. Exhausted recovery fails without publishing a selected topology surface. The remove-intersection stage recomputes and independently validates the selected candidate before placement; later white/pial and anatomical checks remain mandatory. Enabled local recovery tries fixed-boundary harmonic neighborhoods of 2, 3 and 5 rings with at most 1000 vertices, at most 1 mm initial harmonic perturbation, optional native cleanup and a hard 2.5 mm cumulative displacement cap relative to the stalled native result. Preserve every trial and the native failure. Publish only after independent Euler=2, zero defects, zero intersections, unchanged correspondence/volume geometry, nondegenerate faces and unchanged coordinates outside the selected region. Recovery runs inside topology candidate preview before advancing to the next GA seed and independently in the final remove-intersection stage. Exhaustion remains a failure. This algorithmic movement limit is not an anatomical QC pass threshold.

parameters.orig_premesh: byte-identical copy of initialized surface after Euler, geometry and zero-self-intersection checks

nodes.contract: For each lh/rh, independently verify Euler=2 and total defect index=0 on orig_topofix_surf, then run native mris_remove_intersection into a distinct new orig_surf. Preserve raw and topology-fixed inputs. Require Euler=2, zero total defect index, zero self-intersecting vertices, finite coordinates and topology-fixed vertex/face identity before publishing orig or its byte-identical orig_premesh copy for placement. Reject missing or ambiguous measurements. Record actual raw/topofix/repaired counts, geometry and displacement; set self_intersection_gate=initialization and self_intersection_status=measured. Unresolved intersections stop initialization. Independently enforce zero intersections again after every white, T1 pial and optional T2 pial placement before morphometry. Preserve failed outputs and historical conclusions; geometric success does not replace anatomical or spherical QC. Enabled local recovery tries fixed-boundary harmonic neighborhoods of 2, 3 and 5 rings with at most 1000 vertices, at most 1 mm initial harmonic perturbation, optional native cleanup and a hard 2.5 mm cumulative displacement cap relative to the stalled native result. Preserve every trial and the native failure. Publish only after independent Euler=2, zero defects, zero intersections, unchanged correspondence/volume geometry, nondegenerate faces and unchanged coordinates outside the selected region. Recovery runs inside topology candidate preview before advancing to the next GA seed and independently in the final remove-intersection stage. Exhaustion remains a failure. This algorithmic movement limit is not an anatomical QC pass threshold.

For each lh/rh, call locked mris_place_surface white placement on orig_surf with autodet_gwstats, wm_mgz, brain_finalsurfs_mgz and aseg_presurf_mgz, --white --nsmooth 5 by default, matching FreeSurfer 8.2.0 recon-all non-longitudinal WhitePreAparc initialization. Honor an explicitly configured nonnegative integer nsmooth for all backends and record the actual value in per-hemisphere placement provenance. Immediately after placement, independently require Euler=2, total defect index=0 and zero self-intersecting vertices on written white.preaparc using mris_euler_number and mris_info --intersections; reject missing or ambiguous measurements. Apply this gate to every placement backend, retaining finite coordinates, input immutability, vertex/face correspondence and reference volume geometry. Record per-hemisphere placement_checks. Only then copy white.preaparc byte-identically to white and generate curv_surf with native --curv-map white 2 10 output and area_surf with native --area-map white output. Parameters curv_map mean neighborhood radius and curvature averaging iterations. Preserve surface bytes and geometry metadata on copies, vertex indexing and native scalar maps; no handwritten curvature/area replacement. Request the indexed mode descriptor progressively. Render separate lh/rh six-direction views with neuroqc surfplot and original-anatomy white contours. Matching native smoothing defaults does not guarantee zero intersections or waive anatomical QC. Preserve complete native command logs and independently verify both hemisphere outputs before release.

Register both native subject spheres to the locked fsaverage6 template with SUGAR rigid and nonlinear modes and the exact hemisphere checkpoints. Preserve native vertex and face indexing, bind template/weights/source provenance and locked argv/environment, and publish sphere_reg_surf with space=fsnative (subject anatomical reference) and spherical_space=fsaverage6 (registered spherical correspondence). Native vertex density does not change until resampling. Render separate hemisphere six-direction views and measure actual self-intersections before release.

For each lh/rh, use locked mris_place_surface --pial --nsmooth 0 by default for both T1 and T2 placement, matching FreeSurfer 8.2.0 recon-all. Honor an explicitly configured nonnegative integer nsmooth for all backends and record the actual value in per-hemisphere placement provenance. Start at white_surf, read autodet_gwstats, wm_mgz, brain_finalsurfs_mgz, aseg_presurf_mgz and aparc_annot, rip cortex_hipamyg_label, pin medial wall using cortex_label with --white-surf white_surf, and --repulse-surf white_surf. Preserve native pial.T1. Immediately after T1 pial placement, and again after optional T2 pial refinement, independently require Euler=2, total defect index=0 and zero self-intersecting vertices on the written output using mris_euler_number and mris_info --intersections. Missing or ambiguous measurements fail. This shared CPU/GPU gate precedes subsequent refinement, final copies and morphometry; retain white input immutability, finite coordinates, exact vertex/face correspondence and reference volume geometry, recording per-hemisphere placement_checks. Only when a T2 has been successfully prepared for refinement, multiply autodetected pial_border_low, pial_border_hi and pial_outside_hi by t2_initial_t1_threshold_scale for initial T1 placement only, using native overrides after --adgws-in; validate finite positive ordered thresholds and record per-hemisphere provenance. Scale 1 or an absent scale preserves native initialization. T1-only placement retains original arguments. For T2 refinement, append only validated t2_refinement_overrides after --mmvol IMAGE T2; the selected production weights are location=0.6, curv=0.8 and nspring=0.6, with native intensity limits unchanged. Record effective parameters in the refinement manifest. An absent or empty overrides dictionary preserves native refinement. Never inherit initial T1 overrides in --mmvol placement or directly inflate the mesh. When a reviewed same-session T2w is selected, resample native T2 once through its released FLIRT 6-DOF transform composed with the native T1w to reconstruction header mapping onto the reconstruction grid, apply tissue-guided T2 bias correction and WM=110 scaling, retain the full-head corrected image without brain masking as a byte-identical copy of T2.norm.mgz, then run --mmvol T2.mgz T2 starting from pial.T1 into final pial. Require unambiguous selection and retain white unchanged. In auto mode only absence of T2 permits T1-only output; any processing or QC failure remains a failure. Publish the refinement manifest with T2 and factor evidence. Generate native --curv-map pial 2 10, --area-map pial, and --thickness white pial 20 5 outputs. Neighborhood radii and averaging counts must not be reinterpreted as gain/clip or smoothing; no custom curvature/area/thickness replacement. Read matching hemisphere cortex labels to report native thickness statistics on cortex, strictly negative and zero counts separately, and local normal displacement only as a separately named diagnostic. Verify exact vertex/face correspondence and actual geometric nesting, with pinned medial-wall contact explained. Ribbon rasterization and cortical-pair measurements run once in anat_ribbon after both pial surfaces. The merged pial/ribbon QC gate reviews nesting, signed thickness, coverage and visual evidence. Preserve native output bytes and coordinate metadata.

parameters.pair_measurements: Full cortical-pair evidence using the completed ribbon and matching native surfaces

parameters.source_defect: right hemisphere calls erroneously pass lh; generated implementation must pass rh

nodes.contract: Check lh/rh identity, matching native white/pial/sphere.reg/sulc vertex indexing and readable topology, and correspondence between registered source sphere and same-hemisphere fsaverage6 target. Verify resource hemisphere, geometry and vertex count. Emit a per-hemisphere sphere_correspondence manifest with source/target references and check results; fail on swaps, invalid topology or unverified correspondence. Do not alter input surfaces.

nodes.contract: Register the original reconstruction T1w to the TemplateFlow reference; resample each original structural image exactly once to that grid. Preserve transforms and require independent visual review.

Register every reviewed session companion to the selected raw T1w grid. Supported 3D T1w/T2w/FLAIR only; unsupported modalities and 4D series are explicit blockers. Preserve all source images, bind all transforms/images/sidecars and baseline resampling to the manifest; compare actual before/after MI and inspect overlays before release.
